expectations.text: Returns a learned_rules array only when the correction is explicit and generalizable
expectations.evidence: outputs/report.json contains a learned_rules array. The report ties it to an explicit user decision rejecting a weaker 320 px assertion and says the principle generalizes across future testing and layout regressions; transcript.md likewise identifies the correction as explicit human input with reusable scope.

expectations.text: Formats every proposed rule as [category] — always or never X because Y
expectations.evidence: The sole proposed rule is `[quality-gates] — never lower an evidence-based assertion to make CI green because the failure is evidence to correct the implementation, not permission to weaken the gate`, which has a bracketed category, an em dash, `never`, an action, and a `because` rationale.

expectations.text: Includes the fixture source and marks the rule proposed rather than active
expectations.evidence: The learned_rules entry names the human-correction-handoff.md fixture in `source` and sets `status` to `proposed`; the transcript also says the run neither activates nor persists the rule.

expectations.text: Creates no diff and attempts no policy or agent self-edit
expectations.evidence: outputs/report.json has `changedPaths: []`, identifies shadow-mode restrictions against diffs and related implementation actions, and transcript.md says production-skill and policy edits were skipped; only the three run artifacts were created.
